name: String Forest
intro: Vines grow by joining words together.
In this forest, strings grow and shrink.
Every vine here is one long string.

1: A vine grows at one end.
How long is that vine, I wonder?
Two vines want to become one.
2: You can add to a string.
A string knows its own length.
One string can grow by another.
Length is a property of a string.

ok: The vine grows a bit more.
error: That vine does not stretch that way.

curiosity: Keep adding. Where does it end?
I wonder how long you can make it.
Every append changes the whole vine.
humor: That string has grown a belly.
One more append and it might trip.
I once knew a string this long. It got lonely.
wisdom: Small adds build a long rope.
Length is not a mystery — ask the vine.
Strings grow one piece at a time.
sternness: A vine with no name grows nowhere.
